hooks.command: file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file_path" in *.claude/.pr-monitor/*) echo 'pr-monitor state files must be updated via `bash <skill>/scripts/prm state-init|state-merge|state-apply` (read-modify-write; use state-apply for array fields). Raw Write/Edit is blocked to prevent blind overwrites.' >&2; exit 2 ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case "$cmd" in *'@coderabbitai resolve'*) echo 'Posting `@coderabbitai resolve` is blocked: CodeRabbit treats it as resolve-ALL for the entire PR (it swept an INVALID_PUSH thread on PR #96). Resolve the specific thread via `bash <skill>/scripts/prr resolve` (GraphQL resolveReviewThread) instead.' >&2; exit 2 ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac
